set.body: Reproduce and correct permissive catalog companion classification: filename substring confounds and desc-brain on non-mask images can become scientific companions. Own shared compiler role checks and JVM header admission alignment, with JVM/JS adversarial fixtures, missing/ambiguous companion behavior, optional confounds and consumer proof. PLSNeuro E1.3 bd-01M1SATXZF1QS52Q1DVCNXVTKT owns adoption and display of source paths.
